class.name: WorldPartition3D
class.brief_description: Streams 3D scene cells around observers and pinned gameplay locations.
class.description: [WorldPartition3D] divides its local X/Z plane into square cells and loads registered [PackedScene] resources around a primary observer node and optional additional observers. The Y coordinate does not influence cell selection. Each registered scene must have a [Node3D] root; the root's local position is offset by the cell origin. Each cell is described by a [Vector2i] coordinate and a scene resource path in [member cell_scenes]. Assets are requested on background threads; instantiation and deletion happen on the main thread. Request and instantiation budgets limit per-frame work. Additional observers in [member additional_observer_paths] are useful for split-screen cameras, co-op players, cinematic cameras and manual prefetch nodes. Cells are kept when in range of any valid observer, while all observers share the same per-frame request and instance budgets. The [member cell_layers] and [member layer_states] properties enable event-driven activation of runtime groups of cells: a disabled layer overrides pins and observers, and its cached gameplay state remains available. Pinned cells from [method pin_cell] take priority among enabled cells, followed by the nearest grid rings of all observers. Within the same ring the primary observer takes priority, followed by additional observers in array order. Loaded scene roots may optionally implement [code]capture_streaming_state()[/code] and [code]restore_streaming_state(state)[/code]. The streamer captures the former when unloading a cell and applies the latter after instantiation. [method snapshot_cell_states] and [method load_cell_states] provide a save-game bridge; they do not themselves write disk files. The [member load_radius] and [member unload_radius] define square neighborhoods in grid-cell units. The unload radius must not be smaller than the load radius; a larger unload radius prevents repeated loading at cell boundaries. [WorldPartition3D] does not generate terrain, divide an authored scene into cells, or build HLOD meshes. Those authoring stages can produce the [PackedScene] files consumed by this runtime node. [codeblock] var partition := WorldPartition3D.new() partition.cell_size = 128.0 partition.load_radius = 1 partition.unload_radius = 2 add_child(partition) partition.observer_path = partition.get_path_to($Player) partition.set_cell_scene(Vector2i(0, 0), "res://world/cell_0_0.tscn") partition.set_cell_scene(Vector2i(-1, 0), "res://world/cell_-1_0.tscn") [/codeblock] Streaming is disabled while editing a scene; the node processes automatically while the game runs. Call [method update_streaming] if an immediate update is required after moving the observer.

method.name: cell_to_local_position
method.description: Returns the local-space origin of [param cell]. The Y component is always zero.

method.name: clear_cell_layer
method.description: Removes the layer assignment of [param cell], making it eligible for normal distance/pin-based streaming irrespective of inactive layer states. Does not delete the registered scene or its saved gameplay state.

method.name: clear_cell_scenes
method.description: Removes all registered cells and unloads instantiated cells.

method.name: clear_cell_states
method.description: Removes all cached runtime state dictionaries. Does not change scene registrations, pins or already loaded scene objects. If those objects are unloaded later, their optional capture callback may repopulate state.

method.name: clear_pinned_cells
method.description: Releases all runtime cell pins. Cells outside every observer's unload radius become eligible for normal budgeted unloading at the next update.

method.name: erase_cell_state
method.description: Discards the cached gameplay state for a single cell without unloading its scene.

method.name: get_additional_observer_paths
method.description: Returns a copy of the additional observer paths; modifying this array does not change the streamer configuration.

method.name: get_cell_instance
method.description: Returns the currently instantiated [Node3D] scene root for [param cell], or [code]null[/code] if it is not loaded. The returned node is owned by the streamer and can be unloaded at any time; do not retain the reference across streaming updates without checking [method @GlobalScope.is_instance_valid]. Useful for controlling proxy visibility when layering detail and distant scene streamers.

method.name: get_cell_layer
method.description: Returns the assigned layer name for this cell, or an empty string when no layer is assigned.

method.name: get_cell_layers
method.description: Returns a copy of [member cell_layers]. Modifying the result does not change the layer configuration.

method.name: get_cell_scene
method.description: Returns the registered scene path or an empty string if none exists.

method.name: get_cell_state
method.description: Returns a deep copy of the stored gameplay state for a cell, or an empty dictionary if none is stored. This does not invoke capture on active scenes; use [method snapshot_cell_states] to gather their latest state.

method.name: get_cell_state_count
method.description: Returns the number of cells with nonempty cached gameplay state.

method.name: get_cells_in_radius
method.description: Returns all coordinates in the square centered on [param center], including the boundary. The radius must be between 0 and 32 inclusive.

method.name: get_configured_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered scene paths, whether loaded or unloaded.

method.name: get_layer_states
method.description: Returns a copy of [member layer_states]. Missing layer names are enabled by default.

method.name: get_loaded_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of tracked instantiated cells.

method.name: get_loaded_cells
method.description: Returns the cell coordinates of currently instantiated scenes.

method.name: get_pinned_cell_count
method.description: Returns the number of runtime pins, including pins not mapped to any registered scene.

method.name: get_pinned_cells
method.description: Returns a new array of the pinned [Vector2i] coordinates in insertion order. No more than 128 cells may be pinned at once.

method.name: has_cell_state
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a nonempty gameplay state is cached for the cell.

method.name: is_cell_layer_enabled
method.description: Returns whether a cell's assigned layer permits it to load. Unassigned cells are enabled. This does not imply that a scene is currently loaded.

method.name: is_cell_loaded
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the cell has a living instantiated scene.

method.name: is_cell_pinned
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a cell is pinned, even if it has no registered scene.

method.name: is_layer_enabled
method.description: Returns the effective runtime state of the named layer. An unregistered layer or empty name defaults to enabled.

method.name: load_cell_states
method.description: Replaces the entire state cache with valid [Vector2i] to [Dictionary] mappings, ignoring other entries. Passes deep copies into active scene roots that implement [code]restore_streaming_state(state)[/code]. Empty dictionaries are ignored. Caller is responsible for validating save files before invoking this method.

method.name: local_position_to_cell
method.description: Converts a local-space position to its grid coordinate using floor division. Negative positions belong to negative cells.

method.name: pin_cell
method.description: Keeps a registered scene cell loaded independent of observer distance, including when no observer exists. Pins are prioritized before spatial requests, while the same threaded request and instantiation budgets apply. An unregistered coordinate is remembered but cannot load a scene until it is registered. Pinned cells do not bypass [member streaming_enabled]. Up to 128 distinct cells may be pinned.

method.name: remove_cell_scene
method.description: Unregisters [param cell] and unloads its existing instance.

method.name: set_additional_observer_paths
method.description: Registers up to 16 extra [NodePath] observer references. Empty, duplicate, and non-[NodePath] entries are discarded. The observer paths are resolved relative to this node, and must point to living [Node3D] instances to affect streaming.

method.name: set_cell_layer
method.description: Assigns [param cell] to a single named layer. Passing an empty layer removes its assignment. A change to an inactive layer unloads its scene over the normal frame budget.

method.name: set_cell_layers
method.description: Replaces the dictionary of [Vector2i] to nonempty [String] layer assignments. Invalid dictionary entries are omitted. Existing scene registrations, pinning and cached gameplay state are preserved.

method.name: set_cell_scene
method.description: Registers a resource path for a cell. An empty path removes the mapping. Replacing a path unloads the previous cell.

method.name: set_cell_state
method.description: Stores a deep copy of [param state] for a cell. An empty dictionary erases a previous cached state. For an active scene root with a [code]restore_streaming_state(state)[/code] method, a copy is applied immediately.

method.name: set_layer_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables a named runtime layer. Disabled layers prevent new loads (including pinned cells), cancel their pending scene instantiations, and unload loaded cells within [member max_unloads_per_frame]. Other layers remain unaffected. Empty names are rejected.

method.name: set_layer_states
method.description: Replaces the dictionary of named runtime states. Only nonempty [String] keys with [bool] values are accepted. Missing layer names are active by default. Useful for restoring event-state data from a save game.

method.name: set_pinned_cells
method.description: Replaces the pinned cell coordinates, preserving the first occurrence of each [Vector2i]. Unsupported array entries are skipped. Arrays with more than 128 entries are rejected without changing existing pins. The normalized result is returned by [method get_pinned_cells].

method.name: snapshot_cell_states
method.description: Captures the latest state of active cell roots implementing [code]capture_streaming_state()[/code], then returns a deep-copy [Dictionary] of [Vector2i] keys to state dictionaries. Returns only nonempty states. Compatible with [code]FileAccess.store_var(snapshot)[/code] and [code]FileAccess.get_var(false)[/code] when values are serializable Variants without objects. Does not save a file automatically.

method.name: unpin_cell
method.description: Stops keeping this cell loaded independent of observer distance. Cells still within any observer's unload radius remain active; other cells are eligible for regular unload.

method.name: update_streaming
method.description: Polls background requests and updates cells around the observer. The node calls this method every frame while streaming is enabled.

members.member: Additional [NodePath] streaming sources (max 16). Their load and unload neighborhoods are combined with [member observer_path], but resource and instantiation limits remain global to this node.

A dictionary assigning each [Vector2i] cell coordinate to one named [String] runtime layer. Each cell may be assigned to at most one layer. Unassigned cells are always eligible for distance- or pin-based loading.
Dictionary mapping [Vector2i] coordinates to [String] scene resource paths. Invalid keys and values are discarded.
Width and depth of a single square cell in local 3D units.

A dictionary from nonempty layer [String] names to [bool] enabled states. Missing layers are enabled. Disabling a layer unloads its cells, even if they are pinned or near a streaming observer, subject to the normal unload budget.
Radius in cells to load around the observer, between 0 and 32.
Maximum simultaneous background resource-load requests made by this node.
Maximum number of loaded cell scenes instantiated per frame.
Maximum number of new resource-load requests per frame.

Maximum number of out-of-range cell scenes to queue for deletion in one streaming update, between 1 and 128. Remaining cells are considered on subsequent frames. Explicit clear/remove operations and disabling streaming unload immediately without this limit.
Path relative to this node pointing to a [Node3D] observer, such as a player or camera.

List of up to 128 pinned [Vector2i] cell coordinates, editable in the inspector and stored in the scene. Invalid non-[Vector2i] values and duplicates are omitted. Pinned registered scenes are kept loaded independently of observer distance, using the normal async request and scene instantiation budgets. Use [method pin_cell], [method unpin_cell] and [method clear_pinned_cells] to modify them at runtime.
Enables or disables streaming. Disabling unloads tracked instances and preserves cell registrations.
Cells outside this radius are unloaded. Must be at least [member load_radius].

signal.name: cell_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after a [PackedScene] is instantiated as a child of this node.

signal.name: cell_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method set_cell_state] changes a cached per-cell state or when a loaded scene returns new data from [code]capture_streaming_state()[/code] on unloading or snapshot. The signal carries an independent [Dictionary] copy, including an empty dictionary when a state is erased. Reassigning identical state data does not emit. [method load_cell_states] is a bulk import and does not emit this signal for each cell.

signal.name: cell_unloaded
signal.description: Emitted when a previously instantiated cell is queued for deletion.

signal.name: layer_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method set_layer_enabled] or [method set_layer_states] changes a layer's effective enabled state. Unspecified layers default to enabled, so explicitly setting such a layer to [code]true[/code] does not emit. Bulk state replacement reports affected layers individually, including layers which become enabled again by removal of an explicit disabled entry.
